measured_defects.title: A mobile user cannot reach the question box without scrolling past a whole form
measured_defects.reading: The question input begins at 2009px, about 2.4 viewport heights down. The structured 'Set your forecast window' panel occupies the entire first screen and ends at 945px, already past the fold.
measured_defects.requirement: P13 mobile requirement; docs/14 stage 5 desktop usability gate

measured_defects.title: The forecast refresh control is not reachable in the live product path
measured_defects.reading: send() accepts a refresh flag and never reads it. The only refresh button lives in render(), which cannot execute. POST /api/refresh is implemented and served but has no caller in the UI, so a user can never request a bounded collection from the workspace.
measured_defects.requirement: P10 freshness; docs/14 stage 5 recovery gate

measured_defects.title: A whole unreachable legacy renderer is retained and its fallback request shape is rejected by the engine
measured_defects.reading: The ternary can never select render(). The dead branch also posts entity_id, which ConversationEngine.ask rejects as an unknown key, so it would fail rather than degrade if it ever ran.

measured_defects.title: The UI presents a task-completion count that the governing review says cannot be trusted
measured_defects.reading: docs/21 A07 and P12 record that an empty or contradictory explanation task is still counted as completed. The workspace surfaces that count unqualified and in the affirmative.
measured_defects.requirement: docs/21 repair item 1: requested, planned, executed and answered must be reviewed separately

measured_defects.title: Capability scope text is stale against the connected tools and the UI offers no language control

scope_block_lists: point forecasts with hourly probability, feels-like, gusts, visibility
daily ERA5 up to seven days
published historical rainfall and national climate

measured_defects.reading: docs/23 connects marine and river tools; docs/13 and 22 expose airport and warning diagnostics. None appear in 'What this version can answer'. Output language can only be requested in free text, which docs/21 A02 shows is not honoured, and the UI cannot express or disclose the requested output language.

measured_defects.title: Two competing question inputs, one of which silently rewrites the other

evidence.builder_behaviour: synthesises an English sentence into #question then submits that same question
evidence.example_chips_position: between the answer card and the composer

measured_defects.reading: The form is a query builder for a grammar the conversation engine no longer requires, and it overwrites whatever the user typed. Example chips sit below answers they no longer relate to. The marketing hero and its duplicate input path keep the actual product below the fold on every turn.

verified_live_turn.question: Will it rain in Ahmedabad, Gujarat tomorrow morning?
verified_live_turn.answer_text: Ahmedabad · 15 Sep, 06:30–15 Sep, 12:30 IST: Forecast precipitation: 0.3 mm. Source: GFS forecast; conditions can change.
verified_live_turn.raw_json_inspector: details > pre with the whole packet
verified_live_turn.reading: The turn is correct and inspectable. The presentation is dense: one run-on paragraph holds place, window, value, source and caveat, while the surrounding shell keeps a marketing hero and an unrelated example-chip row.

conversation_storage.reading: Conversations persist server-side but cannot be listed, restored or deleted through the workspace, so there is no retention or restore journey. data/runtime/ is git-ignored, so this store is deliberately outside curated evidence.
